title: Allow multiple Sticky Note applets to reference the exact same note (useful with external screen)
line: A Sticky Note widget can now show the same note as another Sticky Note widget, and edits in one appear in the other.
explanation: Every Sticky Note widget always had its own note file, and since 6.5 two widgets asking for the same file get separate copies (so cloned panels don't share by accident). There was no way to make the widgets on two screens' panels show one note. The settings page now has a "Note:" choice listing the notes of the other Sticky Note widgets; picking one stores it as the widget's shared note (its own note is kept for switching back), the copy-on-clone logic only applies to widgets using a note as their own, removing a widget no longer trashes a note another widget still shows, and existing file watching keeps the widgets in sync.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow showing another widget's note

Each Sticky Note widget always had its own note, so with a panel on each
screen there was no way to keep one note in both. The settings now offer
to show the note of another widget instead, and both stay in sync.

BUG: 515504
